key_insight: The paper shows that the quantum Fourier transform can be partitioned across multiple QPUs more efficiently by optimally packing gates to reduce entanglement cost while preserving the circuit’s unitary action.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical route to scaling quantum hardware via distributed execution, where minimizing e-bit generation is critical for lower communication overhead and better feasibility.
method: Design a QFT partitioning scheme based on optimal gate-packing.
Compare the scheme with prior analytical QFT partitioning methods.
Benchmark against general-purpose circuit partitioning algorithms and hardware implementation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports comparative evaluation of the proposed partitioning approach and validation by running the partitioned circuit on quantum hardware.
watch_item: Performance depends on distributed hardware and teleportation overhead, so theoretical e-bit savings may not fully translate to end-to-end execution gains.
paper_title: Towards an Optimally Distributed Quantum Fourier Transform Circuit
